_readme: Waivers for scripts/visual-gate.mjs. A check named here may fail without failing the gate, because it describes a defect a later story owns. The ratchet turns one way only: when a waived check starts passing, the gate FAILS until its entry is deleted here. Adding an entry is how you record a known defect; deleting one is part of the story that fixes it. Never add an entry to get a run green.

hud-round-pips-advance.why: Story 12.6 draws the round pips and settles the HUD's layout in one story, so that 12.7 fills an element that is already there rather than relaying a finished HUD around a new one. There is nothing for a pip to count until the round system exists: no Match in this build has more than one round, and no state field records a round won. The check is written now, fails now, and 12.7 deletes this entry when a pip fills.
